records.found: On 2026-10-27 the trial registry posted the first results of the National Institutes of Health low-dose danazol trial (NCT03312400), and its status now reads terminated for poor accrual with 18 people enrolled; the site's records call it completed. Its main measure was how many people had their telomere shortening rate cut by at least half, not telomere lengthening (5 of 8 on 200 mg and 5 of 10 on 400 mg), so it does not meet the test and no regulator approval turned up.

findings.what: Results first posted for NCT03312400 (low-dose danazol in telomere disease, NIH Clinical Center, phase 2). Status terminated, 'stopped due to poor accrual'; 18 enrolled; study end 2025-10-31. Primary measure: people with at least a 50 per cent reduction in telomere attrition rate at 24 weeks (200 mg: 5 of 8; 400 mg: 5 of 10 as read from the arm and response counts). Authors' caveat: early closure limited statistical power. No peer-reviewed paper seen.
TELO-SCOPE (NCT04638517) remains terminated for futility; last update 2025-08-05, so nothing new in the window.

records.found: On 2026-11-04 Intellia announced that enrolment in its nerve-disease late-stage trial of the in-body gene editor nex-z (MAGNITUDE-2) is complete, with more than the 60 people planned, and its 2026-11-05 quarterly report says enrolment in the heart-disease trial (MAGNITUDE) has advanced significantly and that it began giving investigators immune-gene (HLA) genotyping results in the third quarter. The registry shows MAGNITUDE-2 now active, not recruiting (updated 2026-11-05, primary completion estimated 2027-07) and MAGNITUDE still recruiting (updated 2026-11-04, primary completion 2027-12).

findings.what: Intellia Q3 2026 results: MAGNITUDE-2 enrolment complete, above the 60 target; MAGNITUDE enrolment advanced significantly; HLA genotyping results being given to investigators from Q3. No mention of a clinical hold or liver events in the release as read via a wire copy. Official company page refused automated access (403).

Enrolment in MAGNITUDE-2 (hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis with nerve damage) announced complete; single 55 mg infusion vs placebo, 1:1; main measures nerve impairment score at month 18 and blood transthyretin at day 29.
Registry: MAGNITUDE-2 (NCT06672237) active not recruiting, 67 enrolled, primary completion estimated 2027-07, completion 2028-08.
Registry: MAGNITUDE (NCT06128629) recruiting, about 1,200 planned, primary completion estimated 2027-12, completion 2028-04; entry updated, no hold noted.

records.story_why: A short news post fits: the first of the two late-stage trials of an in-body gene editor has finished enrolling after the safety pause, with a first possible read-out in 2027 to 2028. Bears on the estimate in that the nerve-disease trial reaching full enrolment supports the 'earliest' year of 2028 and shows the liver-safety pause did not end the programme; it does not move the likely year of 2030.
